title: New Magnetic and Luminescent Dy(III) and Dy(III)/Y(III) Based Tetranuclear Silsesquioxane Cages

material_class.structural_family: prism-like cage metallasilsesquioxane with a tetranuclear oxo core between two cyclic tetraphenylcyclotetrasiloxanolate ligands

synthesis.procedure: Shared two-step route adapted from a previous method: in situ formation of phenylsiloxanolate [PhSi(O)ONa]x, followed by self-assembly with Dy3+/Y3+ salts in 1/3 stoichiometry and Et4NCl. Crystallization from an acetonitrile/ethanol mixture gave single crystals of 1. The main text states that experimental details are in the Supporting Information; numerical masses, volumes, time, temperature, and yield are not given in the main text.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: two-step self-assembly followed by crystallization from acetonitrile/ethanol
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallization from an acetonitrile/ethanol mixture afforded X-ray-quality single crystals.

properties.summary: Room-temperature χT matches one Dy3+ ion in a statistically Y/Dy-substituted tetranuclear core. Magnetization at 1.8 K does not saturate, consistent with anisotropy. Only 1 shows field-induced slow magnetic relaxation (SMM) under 1800 Oe, with a fitted barrier of 49±4 cm−1 and a dominant Raman contribution. Solid-state Dy3+ green-yellow emission is observed; ligands do not efficiently sensitize Dy3+. Stark components of the 4F9/2 and 6H15/2 manifolds were extracted at 77 K and compared with the magnetic barrier.

synthesis.procedure: Same two-step self-assembly as 1 using in situ [PhSi(O)ONa]x, Dy3+ salt (1/3 stoichiometry), and Et4NCl (Cat = Et4N), then crystallization from acetonitrile/ethanol. Quantitative experimental details are stated to be in the Supporting Information and are not given in the main text.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: two-step self-assembly followed by crystallization from acetonitrile/ethanol

properties.summary: χT at room temperature matches four free Dy3+ ions. χT decreases on cooling from crystal-field depopulation and antiferromagnetic Dy···Dy interactions. M(H) at 1.8 K is S-shaped and does not saturate (24.6 Nβ at 5 T). No slow relaxation of the magnetization is observed, attributed to intramolecular magnetic interactions. Solid-state Dy3+ green-yellow emission is present but poorly resolved, consistent with energy transfer and nonradiative decay among the four Dy3+ ions.

properties.summary: Room-temperature χT is close to four free Dy3+ ions. Cooling decreases χT, and M(H) at 1.8 K is S-shaped (21.9 Nβ at 5 T), consistent with antiferromagnetic coupling and anisotropy. No ac slow relaxation is reported. Solid-state Dy3+ green-yellow luminescence is observed and is less resolved than for the diluted Y/Dy cage 1.
